title: Persistence architecture & terminology
gist: Deploy the existing party/ Yjs/Partykit stack (infra fix, not a rewrite). Rename "Portfolio" -> "Roadmap" in UI copy only. Local-only "/" page keeps a red 45° "Local storage version, not stored in DB" watermark.

title: Combined multi-Program editor & cross-program move design
gist: Shared time axis, collapsible Program bands, fully live-editable (all Programs connected, typical scale 3-4). Cross-Program move via Program/Swimlane dropdowns in the milestone & swimlane editors, one shared move primitive. Structure editor is Program-tabbed; canvas always stays combined.

title: Multi-Roadmap access & Version History semantics
gist: "My Roadmaps" lists every role (owner/editor/viewer), owned-first, no migration needed. "Save a version" = manual, whole-Roadmap capture, new term "Version" (not Snapshot). v1 is view-only browsing; restore-to-live deferred.

title: Deploy party/ realtime backend to Cloudflare + wire production persistence
gist: Deployed + verified via a second incognito session. Also found & fixed along the way: NewDocumentBanner always said "blank template" even after real extraction; onStartNew never cleared localStorage so a 2nd document always got clobbered by the 1st; Google sign-in was minting a new random identity every session (fixed via account.providerAccountId in the jwt callback) -- see #130's Notes for the landmine.

title: Autosave status indicator + retire the misleading file-download Save button
gist: Added a toolbar SyncStatusIndicator ("Saved"/"Syncing…"/"Offline — changes pending") reading useProgramRoom's existing status/showOfflineBadge. File ‣ Save/Save & Start New now read "Download a copy" on any realtime-connected page; unauthenticated local-only "/" keeps "Save".

title: Prototype: "My Roadmaps" landing page UX
gist: Picked Option C — sidebar list (All/Owned/Shared filter) + detail pane for the selected Roadmap, over a dense table (A) and a card grid (B). Prototype on branch prototype/my-roadmaps-landing-122, not merged.

title: Build "My Roadmaps" API + New Roadmap flow + landing page
gist: Built GET/POST /api/roadmaps + MyRoadmapsLanding.tsx (mr3's Option C), wired into "/" for signed-in visitors, replacing the old hard-coded link. Closed the "+ New Roadmap" loop: /view now carries role on its empty-Portfolio 404 so /p/[id] offers EntryForm inline via the existing programs/extract endpoint. No new title field — a Roadmap's display name is its first Program's name until it has one.

title: Cross-Program move primitive (milestone + swimlane, across Yjs docs)
gist: Shipped as pure planners (planMilestoneMove/planSwimlaneMove) + a box-dispatch orchestrator #126's dropdowns will call: fresh doc-local ids on the destination side, destination-insert before source-release, and dropped dependsOn / cleared linksToTopLevelMilestone reported on the returned plan rather than silently discarded. The 4 cross-Program reducer actions clear both undo stacks -- history is whole-document snapshots, so an undo crossing the move would resurrect the item as a duplicate. Ordering guarantees never-in-NEITHER Program; it cannot guarantee never-in-BOTH (each Program flushes over its own room connection, no offline persistence), and that window is encoded as a test, not prose. Server-side move ruled out: ProgramRoom only appends to its update log and never re-reads, so a REST write would be invisible to already-connected rooms. No UI -- #126 wires the dropdowns. Follow-up #131 filed for scenario-override re-pointing after a move.

title: Prototype: combined multi-Program editor UX
gist: Picked Option B -- a permanent left Program rail (no structure-editor tabs at all: the expanded rail card IS the tab), combined canvas to its right always showing every Program. Band collapse is a per-card rail toggle INDEPENDENT of which card is expanded, so a Program can be restructured while its band is collapsed. Milestone editing is a right-docked inspector rather than a modal (canvas stays visible while you move something out of a band), with the cross-Program Program+Swimlane pair as its first line above the dropped-edges warning; a swimlane moves via a per-lane arrow button that expands the same picker inline. Rejected A (bottom dock + spreadsheet tabs: permanent vertical cost, collapse state buried behind a tab switch) and C (drawer over the canvas: covers the Programs you're moving between; breadcrumb-as-move makes a cross-document move read like a rename). Decided on top of the verdict: the inspector replaces MilestoneEditorModal on the SINGLE-Program page (RoadmapWorkspace) too, so #126 is "turn the modal into a docked inspector both surfaces render" -- TopLevelItemEditorModal follows it, and re-flowing the modal's max-w-4xl/grid-cols-[1fr_260px] body into one narrow column is the real work. Prototype on branch prototype/combined-multi-program-editor-125, not merged.

title: Build combined multi-Program editor
gist: Built as #125's Variant B: permanent left Program rail (the structure editor, no tabs), merged canvas always showing every Program, one live Yjs room per Program (ProgramRoomHost) and merged-dispatch.ts routing a namespaced canvas id to its owning Program's box — the editing-dispatch half CONTEXT.md flagged as unbuilt since t26. MilestoneEditorModal became a 380px docked inspector on BOTH surfaces (TopLevelItemEditorModal followed it), with the cross-Program move as its first line and a per-lane ⇄ in the rail; both preview what the move drops by running #124's own planner. Band collapse is viewer-local (a band is synthesized by the merge, so no doc field to write); a real Swimlane Group's collapsed still routes to its box. t33's bulk-edit toolbar now applies through the live boxes, leaving the bulk-patch route callerless. Deferred: Portfolio-level editing (theme/categories) on this surface, and share-link guests.

title: Prototype: Version History UX
gist: Picked Option B -- Version History is a right-docked History dock in the SAME slot as the milestone inspector (EDITOR_DOCK_WIDTH, 380px), closed by default and mutually exclusive with it; selecting a row swaps the canvas IN PLACE beneath it with the list still on screen, and arrow up/down steps through Versions, because the real act is comparing until you find the one you meant, not reading one. Entry point is a History toggle next to the sync indicator, not Options (where Export Snapshot lives -- the collision #128 renames away). 'Live document' is a pinned first row rather than a Back button, so entering and leaving read-only are the same click. Read-only is expressed by WITHHOLDING the mutation callbacks (the route's own pre-#126 convention), not a scrim; band collapse stays live since it is viewer-local. Save takes one click and no dialog, always captures the live document (even while reading an old Version) and returns to Live; naming is post-hoc via an inline rename on the new row, label only -- content stays append-only. Row change summaries ('+2 milestones - 12 dates moved') need a diff of consecutive full Program sets: ship counts only if that is not cheap at list time. Rejected A (modal + separate read-only route: no comparison without a round trip; list hidden exactly when deciding -- its zero-pixel virtue survives as the dock's closed-by-default state) and C (ribbon over the axis: a chip has no room for who saved it, degrades past ~10 Versions, and spends left/right arrows on scrubbing). Prototype on branch prototype/version-history-127, not merged.

title: Build Version History + rename Export Snapshot copy
Scenario override cleanup for a milestone/swimlane moved across Programs
CI hung for hours then heap-OOMed: an empty Program's domain moved on every render
gist: computeDomain's empty-Program fallback anchored on Date.now(), and computeDomain runs DURING render -- so an empty Program produced a new domain every render, re-firing useZoomWindow's fullDomain effect, which set state, which rendered again: a render loop with no fixed point. It terminated only when two consecutive renders landed in the same millisecond -- near-always true for a small tree on a fast dev machine, near-never true for the real workspace tree on CI, where it spun 2-4h and then heap-OOMed on React re-render garbage. Fixed by anchoring to today's UTC midnight. Neither of the issue's own leads held: the first bad commit is 42aef22d (not 9c7da84d), and axis-tiers' NaN loops were not the cause (hardened anyway). Also fixed a separate npm run build failure that predated the hang -- next build runs NODE_ENV=production, tripping the module-scope requireEnv guards, so the build step now carries placeholder secrets. Landmine for future debugging: --reporter=verbose flushes per FILE, not per test, so a hung file prints nothing and the last name in the log is not where execution stopped. CI: 2-4h + OOM -> 112s green.
